bosses.name: Lord Kazzak
bosses.general: Blasted Lands world boss: Shadow Bolt Volley, Mark of Kazzak drains mana then explodes, Twisted Reflection heals him, Capture Soul heals him on every death. Berserk after 3 minutes.
bosses.tank: Hold him in the open, two tanks.
bosses.healer: Dispel Twisted Reflection; keep everyone alive, deaths heal him.
bosses.dps: A race against 3 minutes; marked players run out.

bosses.name: Emeriss
bosses.general: Dragon of Nightmare: Noxious Breath in front, tail sweep behind, sleeping fog, players who die grow mushrooms. Volatile Infection on a player.
bosses.tank: Face her away from the raid, nature resistance.
bosses.dps: Flanks only; nobody dies near the raid.

bosses.name: Lethon
bosses.general: Dragon of Nightmare: Shadow Bolt Whirl, spawns shades from every player that heal him.
bosses.dps: Kill the shades before they reach him.

bosses.name: Taerar
bosses.general: Dragon of Nightmare: Arcane Blast, Bellowing Roar fears, and splits into three shades.
bosses.tank: Fear Ward; tanks for the shades.
bosses.dps: Kill the shades when he splits.

bosses.name: Ysondre
bosses.general: Dragon of Nightmare: Lightning Wave chains, calls Demented Druid Spirits.
bosses.tank: Face her away; pick up the spirits.
bosses.dps: Spread for the lightning; kill the spirits.
